subject: SIG Intake: section allocations, owner matrix, and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finwave.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finwave.com, procurement@finwave.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request for Redwood — initial questionnaire attached

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for agreeing to take this through our intake process. Attached is the FinWave SIG we use for vendor reviews — it's the 2026 template. Our GRC team needs the completed questionnaire and supporting evidence (network diagrams, SOC 2 references, and key policy artifacts) by the end of next week if possible.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the different SIG sections so we can align reviewers? For context, we typically split to: Access Controls, Data Protection, DevSecOps/Change Management, Identity and Access, Asset Management, and Vendor Management.

If you prefer, send an owner matrix and a single package link (Drive or SFTP). We're flexible on format.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Vendor Risk
FinWave

Attachment: SIG_Questionnaire_2026-05.pdf (application/pdf, 1.1 MB)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG request for Redwood — initial questionnaire attached

Team — forwarding FinWave's SIG intake. Elena asked for section owners and evidence by EOD next Friday (2026-05-28). High level plan below and assignments proposed. Please review and flag conflicts ASAP.

Proposed owner matrix (first pass):
- Access Control (AC): priyom_das (IAM, RBAC, MFA)
- Data Protection & Encryption (DP): mina_haddad (encryption at rest/in transit, key management)
- DevSecOps / Change Management (CM): marissa_cole (deploy pipeline, change approval logs)
- Asset & Inventory Management (AI): markus_klein (asset inventory, inventory cadence)
- Vendor Management (VM) + Business Continuity (BC): stephanie_nguyen (contracts, vendor list, BCP)

Deliverables I need from each owner by 26 May EOD:
1) Completed SIG section PDF (answers filled) or spreadsheet rows
2) Evidence files or links (policy docs, screenshots, exportable logs) — include short notes about scope and redactions if any
3) A single short bullet for "evidence confidence" (green/amber/red)

I attached an evidence index template (redwood_evidence_index_v1.csv) and our latest network diagram for reference. I'll collate and send a single package to Elena on 22 May midday unless you object.

If you prefer, allocate more time for legal review for any sections that touch PII or contract language.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_evidence_index_v1.csv (text/csv), network_diagram_redwood.png (image/png)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request for Redwood — initial questionnaire attached

Acknowledged — I'll own Access Control. Quick notes:
- I'll pull the IAM policy snapshots for the last 90 days and a sample of MFA enforcement logs. Expect files: iam_policy_snapshot.json (redacted), mfa_enforcement_excerpt.csv.
- For any items that reference identity provider settings, I'll include the Okta admin export and a 1-paragraph scope note describing multi-tenant controls.

Marissa — can you confirm you can extract change approvals for the last three releases? We need a CSV or PDF export of approval tickets.

Markus — I'll need the asset inventory export with classification labels. If we don't have a single export, create a short mapping doc.

Mina — please call out whether any encryption keys are customer-scoped vs. system-scoped; that will likely be a FinWave question.

I'll aim to drop my artifacts into the shared Drive folder by EOD 26 May.

- Priyom
Engineering Security Manager
